Interface BotRegistry

public interface BotRegistry
Connects a bot addon to ZonePractice Pro. One BotProvider can be registered at a time. Main thread only.

  • Method Details

    • register

      void register(org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin owner, BotProvider provider)
      Register the bot provider.
      Parameters:
      owner - The plugin that owns the provider
      provider - The provider
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if a provider is already registered
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provider id is invalid

    • unregister

      boolean unregister(BotProvider provider)
      Unregister a provider. Its active bot matches end.
      Parameters:
      provider - The provider
      Returns:
      true if the provider was registered

    • unregisterAll

      void unregisterAll(org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin owner)
      Unregister the provider of a plugin. Called automatically by the core when owner is disabled.
      Parameters:
      owner - The plugin

    • getProvider

      BotProvider getProvider()
      Returns:
      The registered provider, or null

    • isAvailable

      boolean isAvailable()
      Returns:
      true if a provider is registered and available, and the core is ready

    • openSetup

      void openSetup(org.bukkit.entity.Player player, BotOptions options)
      Open the bot practice ladder, arena and round selection. The match starts with options. If bot practice is unavailable or the player is busy, the player is told why instead.
      Parameters:
      player - The player
      options - The bot options chosen by the player

    • start

      String start(org.bukkit.entity.Player player, BotSetup setup)
      Start a bot practice match. If it cannot start, the player is told why.
      Parameters:
      player - The player
      setup - The ladder, arena, rounds and bot options
      Returns:
      null on success, otherwise an error key, for example UNAVAILABLE, INVALID-SETUP, BUSY, CAPACITY, NO-ARENA or FAILED

    • getLastSetup

      BotSetup getLastSetup(org.bukkit.entity.Player player)
      The last bot practice setup the player can start again, for example for a rematch. Expires 1200 ticks after the match ends.
      Parameters:
      player - The player
      Returns:
      The setup, or null

    • reserveEntityId

      UUID reserveEntityId(org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin owner)
      Reserve a new UUID as a bot identity, for a body spawned outside bot matches. Profiles, statistics and lobby handling ignore it until it is released.
      Parameters:
      owner - The plugin that spawns the body
      Returns:
      The reserved UUID

    • releaseEntityId

      void releaseEntityId(UUID entityId)
      Release a UUID reserved with reserveEntityId(Plugin), after its body was removed.
      Parameters:
      entityId - The UUID

    • isBot

      boolean isBot(UUID entityId)
      Parameters:
      entityId - An entity UUID
      Returns:
      true if the UUID belongs to a bot body
